001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.simple.props;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.io.InputStream;
005import java.io.StringReader;
006import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
007import java.lang.System.Logger.Level;
008import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
009import java.util.ArrayList;
010import java.util.List;
011import java.util.Objects;
012import java.util.function.Function;
013import java.util.regex.Pattern;
014
015import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
016
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAlerts;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEventFactory;
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.CaseChanging;
022
023/**
024 * Resolves {@link LogProperties} from the following layers, highest priority first:
025 * <ol>
026 * <li>System properties
027 * ({@link LogProperties.StandardProperties#SYSTEM_PROPERTIES}).</li>
028 * <li>Environment variables, using {@value Builder#DEFAULT_ENV_PREFIX} (configurable) in
029 * place of the {@code "logging."} lead segment of the key, remaining <code>.</code>s
030 * replaced with <code>_</code>, and casing left exactly as-is; see
031 * {@link Builder#envPrefix(String)}.</li>
032 * <li>Profile resources selected by {@value #PROFILES_PROPERTY}, first profile wins.
033 * These are loaded only when the base resource exists. An empty selection uses the
034 * optional {@code default} profile; all other profile resources must exist.</li>
035 * <li>A classpath resource (default {@value Builder#DEFAULT_RESOURCE}, configurable)
036 * parsed the same way {@link LogProperties.Builder#fromProperties(String)} parses any
037 * other properties text. If the base resource is absent, this module supplies no property
038 * sources at all.</li>
039 * </ol>
040 * Create one with {@link #builder()}, or just rely on {@link SimplePropertiesProvider}
041 * picking up the defaults automatically via {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}. The provider
042 * reports selected profiles and classpath resource loading through {@link LogAlerts}.
043 * <p>
044 * <b>GraalVM native image</b>: this module bundles a {@code resource-config.json} (at
045 * {@code META-INF/native-image/io.jstach.rainbowgum/rainbowgum-simple-props/}) that
046 * includes {@code logging.properties} and {@code logging-<profile>.properties}
047 * automatically. Profile names contain only ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and
048 * hyphens. Custom {@link Builder#resource(String)} names and their profile variants need
049 * corresponding native-image resource metadata.
050 */
051public final class SimpleProperties {
052
053        /**
054         * Base-resource key validation. The base resource overrides
055         * {@link Builder#strict(StrictType)}. Accepts {@code off} or {@code false},
056         * {@code alert}, and {@code fail} or {@code true} (default).
057         */
058        public static final String STRICT_PROPERTY = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "simpleprops.strict";
059
060        /**
061         * Controls prefix validation of the base resource's property keys.
062         */
063        @CaseChanging
064        public enum StrictType {
065
066                /** Disables prefix validation. */
067                OFF,
068                /** Records an error alert for each key without the logging prefix. */
069                ALERT,
070                /**
071                 * Records error alerts and fails when supplying properties if any key lacks the
072                 * logging prefix.
073                 */
074                FAIL;
075
076                static StrictType parse(String value) {
077                        return switch (value.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)) {
078                                case "true" -> FAIL;
079                                case "false" -> OFF;
080                                default -> LogProperty.enumValue(StrictType.class, value, "true", "false");
081                        };
082                }
083
084        }
085
086        /**
087         * Comma-separated profiles, in priority order. Resolved from system properties,
088         * environment variables, or {@link Builder#profiles(List)}, in that priority order,
089         * after the base classpath resource is found. With the default environment prefix,
090         * use {@code RAINBOWGUM_profiles}. For example,
091         * {@code logging.profiles=local-dev,dev} loads {@code logging-local-dev.properties}
092         * before {@code logging-dev.properties}, with {@code logging.properties} as fallback.
093         * A missing base resource disables all property sources from this module, regardless
094         * of profile selection. With no profiles selected, the optional {@code default}
095         * profile is used. It is not included automatically when other profiles are selected.
096         * A missing selected profile resource fails initialization unless its name is
097         * {@code default}. Files cannot activate additional profiles.
098         */
099        public static final String PROFILES_PROPERTY = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "profiles";
100
101        private static final Pattern PROFILE_NAME = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_-]+");
102
103        private final List<LogProperties> properties;
104
105        private final List<String> infoMessages;
106
107        private final List<String> errorMessages;
108
109        private final StrictType strict;
110
111        private SimpleProperties(List<LogProperties> properties, List<String> infoMessages, List<String> errorMessages,
112                        StrictType strict) {
113                this.properties = properties;
114                this.infoMessages = infoMessages;
115                this.errorMessages = errorMessages;
116                this.strict = strict;
117        }
118
119        /**
120         * The layers described in this class's javadoc, highest priority first.
121         * @return properties, highest priority first.
122         * @throws IllegalArgumentException if strict validation is {@link StrictType#FAIL}
123         * and the base resource has unprefixed keys.
124         */
125        public List<LogProperties> properties() {
126                if (strict == StrictType.FAIL && !errorMessages.isEmpty()) {
127                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
128                                        "Invalid simple-props base resource:\n" + String.join("\n", errorMessages));
129                }
130                return properties;
131        }
132
133        void reportAlerts(LogAlerts alerts) {
134                for (var message : infoMessages) {
135                        alerts.info(SimpleProperties.class, message);
136                }
137                var eventFactory = LogEventFactory.of(SimpleProperties.class.getName());
138                for (var message : errorMessages) {
139                        alerts.alert(eventFactory.eventNoArg(Level.ERROR, message, null));
140                }
141        }
142
143        private record ProfileResources(List<String> names, List<LogProperties> properties, List<String> resources) {
144        }
145
146        /**
147         * Creates a builder.
148         * @return builder.
149         */
150        public static Builder builder() {
151                return new Builder();
152        }
153
154        /**
155         * Builds a {@link SimpleProperties}.
156         */
157        public static final class Builder {
158
159                /**
160                 * Default environment variable prefix: {@value #DEFAULT_ENV_PREFIX}.
161                 */
162                public static final String DEFAULT_ENV_PREFIX = "RAINBOWGUM_";
163
164                /**
165                 * Default classpath resource: {@value #DEFAULT_RESOURCE}.
166                 */
167                public static final String DEFAULT_RESOURCE = "classpath:/logging.properties";
168
169                private String envPrefix = DEFAULT_ENV_PREFIX;
170
171                private String resource = DEFAULT_RESOURCE;
172
173                private List<String> profiles = List.of();
174
175                private StrictType strict = StrictType.FAIL;
176
177                /**
178                 * Sets base-resource key validation. The base resource's
179                 * {@value SimpleProperties#STRICT_PROPERTY} overrides this setting. Validation
180                 * records error alerts. {@link StrictType#FAIL} also stops initialization when
181                 * properties are supplied.
182                 * @param strict validation mode, default {@link StrictType#FAIL}.
183                 * @return this.
184                 */
185                public Builder strict(StrictType strict) {
186                        this.strict = Objects.requireNonNull(strict);
187                        return this;
188                }
189
190                private Function<String, @Nullable String> envLookup = System::getenv;
191
192                private Builder() {
193                }
194
195                /**
196                 * Sets the environment variable prefix used in place of the key's
197                 * {@code "logging."} lead segment (for example {@code logging.level.root} becomes
198                 * {@code RAINBOWGUM_level_root} with the default prefix). Casing is not touched -
199                 * only the prefix and the remaining <code>.</code>-to-<code>_</code> replacement
200                 * are applied - so a key with mixed-case segments produces a mixed-case
201                 * environment variable name.
202                 * @param envPrefix prefix, default {@value #DEFAULT_ENV_PREFIX}.
203                 * @return this.
204                 */
205                public Builder envPrefix(String envPrefix) {
206                        this.envPrefix = Objects.requireNonNull(envPrefix);
207                        return this;
208                }
209
210                /**
211                 * Sets the classpath resource to load properties from. A leading
212                 * {@code classpath:} scheme (with or without a following <code>/</code>) is
213                 * stripped before resolving; the remainder is resolved as a plain classpath
214                 * resource name. Profile names are inserted before a trailing {@code .properties}
215                 * extension, or appended with a hyphen if there is no such extension. A missing
216                 * base resource makes this module supply no property sources, regardless of
217                 * profile selection. Missing selected profile resources fail when the base
218                 * resource exists, except for the optional {@code default} profile.
219                 * @apiNote unlike the default resource name, a custom one here is not covered by
220                 * this module's bundled GraalVM {@code resource-config.json} - see this class's
221                 * javadoc.
222                 * @param resource classpath resource, default {@value #DEFAULT_RESOURCE}.
223                 * @return this.
224                 */
225                public Builder resource(String resource) {
226                        this.resource = Objects.requireNonNull(resource);
227                        return this;
228                }
229
230                /**
231                 * Sets fallback profiles in priority order. A system property or environment
232                 * variable for {@value SimpleProperties#PROFILES_PROPERTY} overrides this list,
233                 * including when it selects no profiles. Profile names must contain only ASCII
234                 * letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens. An empty selection uses the optional
235                 * {@code default} profile.
236                 * @param profiles fallback profile names, first profile wins.
237                 * @return this.
238                 */
239                public Builder profiles(List<String> profiles) {
240                        this.profiles = List.copyOf(profiles);
241                        return this;
242                }
243
244                /**
245                 * Sets fallback profiles in priority order.
246                 * @param profiles fallback profile names, first profile wins.
247                 * @return this.
248                 * @see #profiles(List)
249                 */
250                public Builder profiles(String... profiles) {
251                        return profiles(List.of(profiles));
252                }
253
254                /*
255                 * Test-only hook so env var mapping can be tested without setting real
256                 * environment variables (which the JVM cannot do portably at test time).
257                 */
258                Builder envLookup(Function<String, @Nullable String> envLookup) {
259                        this.envLookup = Objects.requireNonNull(envLookup);
260                        return this;
261                }
262
263                /**
264                 * Builds the {@link SimpleProperties}.
265                 * @return simple properties.
266                 */
267                public SimpleProperties build() {
268                        var classpathProperties = loadResource(resource);
269                        if (classpathProperties == LogProperties.StandardProperties.EMPTY) {
270                                return new SimpleProperties(List.of(), List.of("No properties resource found: " + resource), List.of(),
271                                                strict);
272                        }
273                        var strictType = classpathProperties.forKey(STRICT_PROPERTY)
274                                .ofString()
275                                .map(StrictType::parse)
276                                .or(strict)
277                                .validateNow(SimpleProperties.class);
278                        var errorMessages = strictType != StrictType.OFF
279                                        && classpathProperties instanceof SimpleLogProperties simple ? simple.prefixErrors()
280                                                        : List.<String>of();
281                        var systemProperties = LogProperties.StandardProperties.SYSTEM_PROPERTIES;
282                        var environmentVariables = new EnvVarProperties(envPrefix, envLookup);
283                        var preProperties = LogProperties.of(List.of(systemProperties, environmentVariables));
284                        var profileResources = preProperties.forKey(PROFILES_PROPERTY).ofList().or(profiles).map(names -> {
285                                if (names.isEmpty()) {
286                                        names = List.of("default");
287                                }
288                                var layers = new ArrayList<LogProperties>();
289                                var resources = new ArrayList<String>();
290                                for (var name : names) {
291                                        if (!PROFILE_NAME.matcher(name).matches()) {
292                                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid profile name '" + name
293                                                                + "': use only ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens");
294                                        }
295                                        String profileResource = resource.endsWith(".properties")
296                                                        ? resource.substring(0, resource.length() - ".properties".length()) + "-" + name
297                                                                        + ".properties"
298                                                        : resource + "-" + name;
299                                        var profileProperties = loadResource(profileResource);
300                                        if (profileProperties == LogProperties.StandardProperties.EMPTY) {
301                                                if (name.equals("default")) {
302                                                        continue;
303                                                }
304                                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing classpath resource '" + profileResource
305                                                                + "' for selected profile '" + name + "'");
306                                        }
307                                        layers.add(profileProperties);
308                                        resources.add(profileResource);
309                                }
310                                return new ProfileResources(List.copyOf(names), List.copyOf(layers), List.copyOf(resources));
311                        }).validateNow(SimpleProperties.class);
312                        var properties = new ArrayList<LogProperties>();
313                        properties.add(systemProperties);
314                        properties.add(environmentVariables);
315                        properties.addAll(profileResources.properties());
316                        properties.add(classpathProperties);
317                        var infoMessages = new ArrayList<String>();
318                        infoMessages.add("Found profiles: " + profileResources.names());
319                        infoMessages.add("Loaded properties resource: " + resource);
320                        for (var profileResource : profileResources.resources()) {
321                                infoMessages.add("Loaded properties resource: " + profileResource);
322                        }
323                        return new SimpleProperties(List.copyOf(properties), List.copyOf(infoMessages), errorMessages, strictType);
324                }
325
326                private static LogProperties loadResource(String resource) {
327                        String path = resource;
328                        if (path.startsWith("classpath:")) {
329                                path = path.substring("classpath:".length());
330                        }
331                        while (path.startsWith("/")) {
332                                path = path.substring(1);
333                        }
334                        ClassLoader cl = SimpleProperties.class.getClassLoader();
335                        if (cl == null) {
336                                cl = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
337                        }
338                        try (InputStream in = cl == null ? null : cl.getResourceAsStream(path)) {
339                                if (in == null) {
340                                        return LogProperties.StandardProperties.EMPTY;
341                                }
342                                String content = new String(in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
343                                return SimpleLogProperties.read(new StringReader(content), resource);
344                        }
345                        catch (IOException e) {
346                                throw new UncheckedIOException("Failed to read classpath resource: " + resource, e);
347                        }
348                }
349
350        }
351
352}
